sources.title: ETV Bharat, 5 August 2026, reporting the Chief Electoral Officer's figures at the draft
Times of India, 6 August 2026, reporting the Chief Electoral Officer's office on the notices to be issued
The Pioneer, 29 September 2026, on the close of claims and objections
The Hindu, 5 August 2026, on the draft roll

notes: Every figure here is the Chief Electoral Officer's as reported in the press. The draft figures and four of the reasons come from ETV Bharat on 5 August 2026, checked against The Hindu, and the notices from the Times of India the next day.
The Chief Electoral Officer's website could not be reached, so no press note or table was read from it.
Four reasons were printed exactly. They are 7,63,903 dead, 14,50,810 not found at their address, 4,38,596 enrolled at more than one place and 1,16,484 other.

The number permanently shifted was not printed exactly in any report read. The names left off less the four printed reasons leave 15,92,194, which agrees with the 15.92 lakh shifted reported by a news agency. Shifted, absent or other is that remainder plus the absent and the other, 31,59,488, so it rests on the remainder.
The reports describe the 1,16,484 other names in two ways. ETV Bharat says foreign nationals or other categories and The Hindu says electors who refused to sign the form. The page calls them other.
A count of 7,63,930 dead was reported on 30 July 2026, before the draft. The draft figure of 7,63,903 is used.

The notices figure is the 63,24,116 electors to be sent a notice. It is 14,03,205 with no link to the earlier roll, 45,55,227 with a logical discrepancy and 3,65,684 with demographically similar entries.
The draft by sex was reported only as 1.12 crore men and 1.08 crore women, so only the 260 third gender electors are shown.
By 30 September 2026, 6,92,597 Form 6 applications to add names and 13,443 Form 7 objections had been received. The final roll is due on 19 October 2026.
